headline: Airtel Africa Completes Citi Buyback Tranche, Repurchasing 12 Million Shares
summary: Airtel Africa completed a share buyback tranche with Citigroup Global Markets, repurchasing 12.03 million ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 278.31 pence per share.
why: Share buybacks reduce total shares outstanding, often signaling management confidence and enhancing per-share earnings metrics for investors.

impacts.name: Airtel Africa PLC
impacts.why: The execution and completion of a major share repurchase tranche returns capital to shareholders.
